brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball-news thumbnail, a wide 16:9 raster illustration, ideally 1600x900 or larger, with all lettering composed in the image. This is a NEW illustration for バスケまとめ.

Editorial source: the fixed article is dated 2026-11-09 and explicitly says all official game records are still awaiting confirmation at 19:08 JST. Do not imply final results or any player's confirmed participation/performance. Do not add scores, rankings, EFF, player names, team names, jersey numbers, or victory claims.

Subject: exactly one REAL basketball player, D.J. Newbill, randomly selected from the ten players named equally in the source. His official Altiri Chiba profile portrait was visually examined in the conversation: https://altiri.jp/club/roster-coaches/2_dj-newbill and https://altiri.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=1788860835/files/user/images/player/26-27/2_dj-newbill.jpg . Use this only to guide likeness, never paste or reproduce the photograph. Preserve his recognisable traits: closely cropped black buzz-cut hair with slightly receding temples, broad forehead, prominent brow, slightly hooded almond-shaped eyes, broad nose and rounded nostrils, full lips, dense neatly shaped full black beard connected to moustache and sideburns, broad jaw, muscular shoulders and sturdy athletic guard build. His upper arms have dark tattoo linework. This is D.J. Newbill, not a generic or fictional player. Do not draw the slim, high curly-haired player from the style example.

Scene: a dynamic low dribble in three-quarter view, knees bent and torso leaning into the drive, face large and clearly visible. Player occupies the LEFT 45 percent, head in upper-left-middle, orange basketball low at left-center held under his natural dribbling right hand. The other hand balances naturally, with anatomically correct wrists and five fingers. Frame from head to mid-thigh; no cropped head, hands or ball. No opponent, no other people. Plain black sleeveless basketball kit with ivory highlights, no letters, numbers, badges, brands or logos anywhere. A loose abstract court brush arc is optional. This is an imagined basketball pose, not a reconstruction of any real game or decisive shot.

Art direction: match the approved black-and-lime thumbnail visible in the conversation, B-culver-black-lime-v3.png, in texture and visual language ONLY. Dark charcoal green-black #151A18 background, sharp acid-lime #CCF43B dry-brush strokes sweeping diagonally behind the player, ivory ink highlights, hand-drawn black-and-white ink illustration with bold brush contours and engraved hatching, orange ball as the only additional color. Energetic editorial sports poster, clearly hand-illustrated and NOT photorealistic. Sparse elements, intentional negative space, exceptionally strong Japanese typography, no complicated interface or tables. Do not carry any name, number or score from the style reference.

Composition: player on left, clean headline area on right 55 percent. A small brand line at upper right, then date/headline, then the crucial qualifier prominently on two lines. The two qualifier lines must be very readable at thumbnail size, with 確定待ち the largest lime text. Avoid brush marks behind lettering. Maintain 5 percent safe margins around all text; no clipping or overlaps. Place the timestamp clearly below the headline block. Put AI disclosure along bottom on a clean dark strip.

Render ONLY the following exact Japanese text, each item once and with no added words:
バスケまとめ
11/09 試合結果
公式記録の
確定待ち
2026.11.09 19:08 JST 時点
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ

The qualifier 公式記録の 確定待ち must be visually as prominent as the date/title, not a tiny disclaimer. The bottom labels イラスト（AI生成） and イメージ must be legible. No official photographs, team logos, league logos, sponsor text, watermarks, decorative pseudo-lettering, or invented statistics. Final output: one clean finished PNG thumbnail.

generator.visual_review: 表示された完成画像を目視確認。全テキストと日付・時刻が固定原稿に一致し、公式記録確定待ちを大きく表示。公式写真と短髪・ひげ・輪郭・目鼻の特徴を照合。左右の手とボール、文字の見切れ、人物と文字の重なりを確認。チーム・リーグ・スポンサーのロゴなし。AI生成とイメージの注記あり。
